mapper.sql: id, member_id, status, note, created_at, updated_at, handled_by, handled_at
mapper.select: select id from ums_member where id = #{memberId} for update
select from member_data_copy_request where member_id = #{memberId} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') order by id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into member_data_copy_request(member_id, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{memberId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update member_data_copy_request set status = #{toStatus}, note = coalesce(#{note}, note), handled_by = #{handledBy}, handled_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id} and status = #{fromStatus}
